summary: Iteration 16: Verified Lightspeed category mapping UUID handling and preprocessing validation. All 8 backend tests + 5 frontend checks passed. DB column migrated to TEXT, UUID string mappings persist correctly, /api/categories/lightspeed returns hierarchy fields (parent_id, leaf_category, category_path), preprocessing marks products with lightspeed mapping as valid. Frontend: Lightspeed categories display as Level 1 (green icon) / Level 2 (indented) hierarchy with L1/L2 badges, NO Category ID column, dropdown shows 'Parent > Child' format for leaf categories, mapping saves and shows green check. Preprocessing page shows HEADWEAR product with Odoo Category 'Not Mapped' but Status 'Ready' - confirming the OR logic works (valid when only lightspeed mapping exists).

issues: Column labelled 'Odoo Category' only - when target platform is Lightspeed, users can't see the mapped Lightspeed category. Consider showing platform-aware category column or both columns.

action_items: (Optional/UX) In Pre-Processing table, show a 'Lightspeed Category' column (or make the category column platform-aware) so users can see when a product is mapped only to Lightspeed.
critical_code_review_comments: routes/categories.py: POST /api/category-mappings has no way to explicitly clear (set NULL) an existing lightspeed_category_id — passing null/empty string is treated as 'no change' because of the `is not None` guard. Consider allowing empty string to explicitly clear the mapping.

routes/categories.py: GET /api/category-mappings does not JOIN with Lightspeed category names, so UI cannot display the human-readable Lightspeed category name for existing mappings without extra client-side lookup.

routes/preprocessing.py: validate_products_for_sync stores only mapping['odoo_category_id'] in product_sync_status.mapped_category_id — Lightspeed mappings are not persisted to sync status. Should also store lightspeed_category_id.
routes/preprocessing.py: get_preprocessing_products joins only odoo_categories for name — no join for Lightspeed category name.
seed_data_creation: Test data created & cleaned up in test: category_mapping row for TEST_HEADWEAR_ITER16 with UUID 9250b0f7-...; ephemeral products + product_media row (deleted in test teardown). No residual test data.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Auth returns {token, user} (NOT access_token). Preprocessing considers a product valid if EITHER odoo_category_id OR lightspeed_category_id is mapped for its supplier category. Lightspeed category IDs are UUID strings; DB column is TEXT. lsHierarchy on frontend uses only categories with !parent_id as roots.
rca of the issue: All three reported bugs are fixed: (1) DB migration ALTER COLUMN lightspeed_category_id TYPE TEXT works (verified via information_schema). (2) POST /api/category-mappings correctly stores UUID string; GET returns identical string. (3) Preprocessing has_category_mapping = mapped_odoo OR mapped_lightspeed — verified by creating a product with only a Lightspeed mapping and confirming is_valid=true, status='ready'.
